## Goal for this is to perform a lot of data exploratnion, get a feel for the data and find some early results visuals


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```




```{r}

## was being weird so i had to add the weird subfolder thing first

plays       <- read.csv("big-data-bowl-data/plays.csv")
player_play <- read.csv("big-data-bowl-data/player_play.csv")
players     <- read.csv("big-data-bowl-data/players.csv")
games       <- read.csv("big-data-bowl-data/games.csv")


```

```{r}
## Add the score differential
plays <- plays %>%
  left_join(games %>% select(gameId, homeTeamAbbr), by = "gameId") %>%
  mutate(score_diff = ifelse(possessionTeam == homeTeamAbbr,
                             preSnapHomeScore - preSnapVisitorScore,
                             preSnapVisitorScore - preSnapHomeScore))
```

```{r}
## Filter to dropbacks on just the downs 1-3, with 10 yards or less, and no garbage time
pass_plays <- plays %>%
  filter(isDropback == TRUE,
         down %in% c(1, 2, 3),
         yardsToGo <= 10,
         qbSpike == FALSE,
         playNullifiedByPenalty == "N",
         quarter <= 4,
         !(quarter == 4 & abs(score_diff) > 16))

nrow(pass_plays)
```


```{r}
## Average get off and time to pressure for the pass rushers on each play


rusher_stats <- player_play %>%
  filter(wasInitialPassRusher == 1) %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId) %>%
  summarize(n_rushers = n(),
            avg_getoff = mean(getOffTimeAsPassRusher, na.rm = TRUE),
            avg_time_to_pressure = mean(timeToPressureAsPassRusher, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")


model_data <- pass_plays %>%
  left_join(rusher_stats, by = c("gameId", "playId"))

dim(model_data)

```


```{r}
## First comparison is play-action vs regular dropbacks

model_data %>%
  group_by(playAction) %>%
  summarize(n = n(),
            mean_epa = mean(expectedPointsAdded, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_getoff = mean(avg_getoff, na.rm = TRUE),
            mean_rushers = mean(n_rushers, na.rm = TRUE),
            missing_getoff = sum(is.nan(avg_getoff) | is.na(avg_getoff)))
```


```{r}

## Regressions controlling for down, distance, field position, and score
epa_model <- lm(expectedPointsAdded ~ playAction + factor(down) + yardsToGo +
                  absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff,
                data = model_data)
summary(epa_model)

getoff_model <- lm(avg_getoff ~ playAction + factor(down) + yardsToGo +
                     absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff,
                   data = model_data)
summary(getoff_model)

```


```{r}
## Control for the number of rushers
getoff_model2 <- lm(avg_getoff ~ playAction + n_rushers + factor(down) + yardsToGo +
                      absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff,
                    data = model_data)
summary(getoff_model2)
```


```{r}
## Get off for defensive linemen only
dl_stats <- player_play %>%
  left_join(players %>% select(nflId, position), by = "nflId") %>%
  filter(wasInitialPassRusher == 1, position %in% c("DE", "DT", "NT")) %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId) %>%
  summarize(dl_getoff = mean(getOffTimeAsPassRusher, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

model_data <- model_data %>%
  left_join(dl_stats, by = c("gameId", "playId"))

dl_model <- lm(dl_getoff ~ playAction + factor(down) + yardsToGo +
                 absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff,
               data = model_data)
summary(dl_model)
```

```{r}


## Did any initial rusher cause pressure on the play?
pressure_stats <- player_play %>%
  filter(wasInitialPassRusher == 1) %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId) %>%
  summarize(any_pressure = max(causedPressure, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

model_data <- model_data %>%
  left_join(pressure_stats, by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  mutate(sack = ifelse(passResult == "S", 1, 0))

## Pressure rate by play type
model_data %>%
  group_by(playAction) %>%
  summarize(n = n(),
            pressure_rate = mean(any_pressure, na.rm = TRUE),
            sack_rate = mean(sack, na.rm = TRUE))
```



```{r}

## Does play-action lower the chance of pressure, with the same controls?
pressure_model <- glm(any_pressure ~ playAction + factor(down) + yardsToGo +
                        absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff,
                      data = model_data, family = binomial)
summary(pressure_model)

```

```{r}

## Play-action effect on get-off, overall and by down
get_effect <- function(data, label, formula) {
  fit <- lm(formula, data = data)
  ci <- confint(fit)["playActionTRUE", ]
  data.frame(group = label,
             estimate = coef(fit)["playActionTRUE"],
             lower = ci[1],
             upper = ci[2])
}

by_down_formula <- avg_getoff ~ playAction + yardsToGo + absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff
overall_formula <- avg_getoff ~ playAction + factor(down) + yardsToGo + absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff

effects <- rbind(
  get_effect(model_data, "All plays", overall_formula),
  get_effect(filter(model_data, down == 1), "1st down", by_down_formula),
  get_effect(filter(model_data, down == 2), "2nd down", by_down_formula),
  get_effect(filter(model_data, down == 3), "3rd down", by_down_formula)
)
rownames(effects) <- NULL

effects$group <- factor(effects$group,
                        levels = c("3rd down", "2nd down", "1st down", "All plays"))

ggplot(effects, aes(x = estimate, y = group)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
                  color = "#0072B2", size = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(estimate, 2), " sec")),
            vjust = -1.2, family = "serif") +
  labs(title = "Play-Action Slows the Pass Rush on Every Down",
       x = "Slower get-off on play-action (seconds, 95% CI)",
       y = NULL) +
  theme_paper

```


```{r}

# 1. Create team_getoff (notice no '+' at the end of this statement)
team_getoff <- model_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(avg_getoff)) %>%
  group_by(defensiveTeam, play_type) %>%
  summarize(mean_getoff = mean(avg_getoff), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = play_type, values_from = mean_getoff) %>%
  mutate(gap = `Play-Action` - `Standard Dropback`) %>%
  arrange(gap) %>%
  mutate(defensiveTeam = factor(defensiveTeam, levels = defensiveTeam))

# 2. Plot team_getoff
ggplot(team_getoff, aes(y = defensiveTeam)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = `Standard Dropback`, xend = `Play-Action`, yend = defensiveTeam),
               color = "#999999") +
  geom_point(aes(x = `Standard Dropback`, color = "Standard Dropback", shape = "Standard Dropback"),
             size = 2.5) +
  geom_point(aes(x = `Play-Action`, color = "Play-Action", shape = "Play-Action"),
             size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pa_colors, breaks = c("Standard Dropback", "Play-Action")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Standard Dropback" = 15, "Play-Action" = 16),
                     breaks = c("Standard Dropback", "Play-Action")) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = 1.2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Every Defense Gets Off the Line Slower on Play-Action",
    x = "Average get-off time (seconds)",
    y = NULL,
    color = NULL, 
    shape = NULL
  ) +
  theme_paper +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))


```




```{r}

## Do some matching

## Put the matching variables into groups
match_data <- model_data %>%
  mutate(dist_group = cut(yardsToGo, breaks = c(0, 3, 6, 10),
                          labels = c("1-3", "4-6", "7-10")),
         field_group = ntile(absoluteYardlineNumber, 4),
         score_group = cut(score_diff, breaks = c(-Inf, -9, -1, 8, Inf),
                           labels = c("Down 9+", "Down 1-8", "Tied or up 1-8", "Up 9+")))


## Keep only groups that have both play-action and standard dropbacks
cells <- match_data %>%
  group_by(down, dist_group, field_group, score_group) %>%
  summarize(n_pa = sum(playAction), n_std = sum(!playAction), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_pa > 0, n_std > 0)

matched <- match_data %>%
  inner_join(cells, by = c("down", "dist_group", "field_group", "score_group")) %>%
  mutate(weight = ifelse(playAction, 1, n_pa / n_std))

## How many plays did we keep?
table(match_data$playAction)
table(matched$playAction)

```


```{r}
## Balance check: are the two play types more similar after matching?
match_data %>%
  group_by(playAction) %>%
  summarize(yardsToGo = mean(yardsToGo),
            field_pos = mean(absoluteYardlineNumber),
            score_diff = mean(score_diff),
            first_down = mean(down == 1))

matched %>%
  group_by(playAction) %>%
  summarize(yardsToGo = weighted.mean(yardsToGo, weight),
            field_pos = weighted.mean(absoluteYardlineNumber, weight),
            score_diff = weighted.mean(score_diff, weight),
            first_down = weighted.mean(down == 1, weight))
```

```{r}
## Effects on the matched plays
getoff_matched <- lm(avg_getoff ~ playAction + factor(down) + yardsToGo +
                       absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff,
                     data = matched, weights = weight)
summary(getoff_matched)

epa_matched <- lm(expectedPointsAdded ~ playAction + factor(down) + yardsToGo +
                    absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff,
                  data = matched, weights = weight)
summary(epa_matched)
confint(epa_matched)["playActionTRUE", ]
```

```{r}

##install.packages(c("lmtest", "car", "sandwich"))


library(lmtest)
library(car)
library(sandwich)

## 1. Diagnostics: constant variance (Breusch-Pagan) and multicollinearity (VIF)
bptest(getoff_model)
bptest(epa_model)
vif(getoff_model)
vif(epa_model)

## Residual plots
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(getoff_model)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(epa_model)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

## 2. Robust standard errors (use these if Breusch-Pagan flags uneven variance)
coeftest(getoff_model, vcov = vcovHC(getoff_model, type = "HC3"))
coeftest(epa_model, vcov = vcovHC(epa_model, type = "HC3"))

## 3. Matched yards model, so the table below is complete
yards_matched <- lm(yardsGained ~ playAction + factor(down) + yardsToGo +
                      absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff,
                    data = matched, weights = weight)

## 4. Results table: play-action effect, unmatched vs. matched
get_b1 <- function(model, label, method) {
  est <- summary(model)$coefficients["playActionTRUE", "Estimate"]
  ci <- confint(model)["playActionTRUE", ]
  data.frame(Outcome = label, Method = method,
             Estimate = round(est, 3),
             Lower = round(ci[1], 3),
             Upper = round(ci[2], 3))
}

results_table <- rbind(
  get_b1(getoff_model, "Get-off time (seconds)", "Regression"),
  get_b1(getoff_matched, "Get-off time (seconds)", "Matched"),
  get_b1(epa_model, "EPA per dropback", "Regression"),
  get_b1(epa_matched, "EPA per dropback", "Matched"),
  get_b1(yards_model, "Yards per dropback", "Regression"),
  get_b1(yards_matched, "Yards per dropback", "Matched")
)
rownames(results_table) <- NULL
results_table

## 5. Pressure results as odds ratios
or_table <- function(model) {
  out <- exp(cbind(OR = coef(model), confint.default(model)))
  round(out, 3)
}
or_table(pressure_model)
or_table(getoff_pressure)

## Effect of a 0.1 second slower get-off on the odds of pressure
exp(coef(getoff_pressure)["avg_getoff"] * 0.1)


## 6. EPA visual: matched estimate vs. regression estimate, with intervals
epa_plot_data <- results_table %>%
  filter(Outcome == "EPA per dropback")

ggplot(epa_plot_data, aes(x = Estimate, y = Method)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper), color = "#0072B2", size = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "Play-Action Shows a Small EPA Gain Under Both Methods",
       x = "Difference in EPA per dropback, play-action minus standard (95% CI)",
       y = NULL) +
  theme_paper

```

```{r}
## Play-action effect on EPA, matched plays, overall and by down group
get_effect_w <- function(data, label, formula) {
  fit <- lm(formula, data = data, weights = weight)
  ci <- confint(fit)["playActionTRUE", ]
  data.frame(group = label,
             estimate = coef(fit)["playActionTRUE"],
             lower = ci[1],
             upper = ci[2])
}

f_all <- expectedPointsAdded ~ playAction + factor(down) + yardsToGo +
  absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff
f_one <- expectedPointsAdded ~ playAction + yardsToGo +
  absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff

epa_effects <- rbind(
  get_effect_w(matched, "All plays", f_all),
  get_effect_w(filter(matched, down == 1), "1st down", f_one),
  get_effect_w(filter(matched, down >= 2), "2nd and 3rd down", f_all)
)
rownames(epa_effects) <- NULL

## Number of play-action plays in each group, for the labels
n_pa <- c("All plays" = sum(matched$playAction),
          "1st down" = sum(matched$playAction & matched$down == 1),
          "2nd and 3rd down" = sum(matched$playAction & matched$down >= 2))

epa_effects <- epa_effects %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(group, "\n(", format(n_pa[group], big.mark = ","), " play-action plays)"),
         label = factor(label, levels = label))

epa_effects

## Fixed plot: labels above the error bars
p_epa3 <- ggplot(epa_effects, aes(x = label, y = estimate)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#0072B2", width = 0.55) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.15,
                color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_text(aes(y = upper, label = round(estimate, 2)),
            vjust = -0.6, family = "serif") +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "EPA gained per dropback from play-action (95% CI)") +
  theme_paper

p_epa3
ggsave("figures/fig2_epa_effect.png", p_epa3, width = 6.5, height = 4, dpi = 300)

## Check 1: how often do offenses pass, by down and distance? (all plays, runs included)
plays %>%
  filter(down %in% c(1, 2, 3), qbKneel == 0, qbSpike == FALSE) %>%
  mutate(dist_group = cut(yardsToGo, breaks = c(0, 3, 6, 10, Inf),
                          labels = c("1-3", "4-6", "7-10", "11+"))) %>%
  group_by(down, dist_group) %>%
  summarize(plays = n(), pass_rate = round(mean(isDropback == TRUE), 3), .groups = "drop")

## Check 2: how many play-action plays are in each down and distance group?
matched %>%
  filter(playAction) %>%
  count(down, dist_group)

## Check 3: play-action effect on EPA by distance group (matched plays)
dist_effects <- bind_rows(lapply(c("1-3", "4-6", "7-10"), function(g) {
  d <- filter(matched, dist_group == g)
  fit <- lm(expectedPointsAdded ~ playAction + factor(down) + absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff,
            data = d, weights = weight)
  ci <- confint(fit)["playActionTRUE", ]
  data.frame(distance = g, n_playaction = sum(d$playAction),
             estimate = round(coef(fit)["playActionTRUE"], 3),
             lower = round(ci[1], 3), upper = round(ci[2], 3))
}))
dist_effects
```


```{r}
## The two groups, from the matched plays
first_down <- filter(matched, down == 1)
third_short <- filter(matched, down == 3, yardsToGo <= 3)

## How many plays in each? (FALSE = standard, TRUE = play-action)
table(first_down$playAction)
table(third_short$playAction)

## Play-action effect on EPA in each group
f_group <- expectedPointsAdded ~ playAction + yardsToGo + absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff

get_eff <- function(data, label) {
  fit <- lm(f_group, data = data, weights = weight)
  ci <- confint(fit)["playActionTRUE", ]
  data.frame(group = label,
             n_pa = sum(data$playAction),
             estimate = coef(fit)["playActionTRUE"],
             lower = ci[1],
             upper = ci[2])
}

short_effects <- rbind(
  get_eff(first_down, "1st down"),
  get_eff(third_short, "3rd and short (3 yards or less)")
)
rownames(short_effects) <- NULL

short_effects <- short_effects %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(group, "\n(", format(n_pa, big.mark = ","), " play-action plays)"),
         label = factor(label, levels = label))

short_effects

## Plot
p_short <- ggplot(short_effects, aes(x = label, y = estimate)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#0072B2", width = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.15,
                color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_text(aes(y = upper, label = round(estimate, 2)),
            vjust = -0.6, family = "serif") +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "EPA gained per dropback from play-action (95% CI)") +
  theme_paper

p_short
ggsave("figures/fig2_epa_first_vs_third_short.png", p_short, width = 6.5, height = 4, dpi = 300)

## Formal check: is the play-action effect different in the two groups?
both <- bind_rows(mutate(first_down, grp = "first"),
                  mutate(third_short, grp = "third_short"))

compare_model <- lm(expectedPointsAdded ~ playAction * grp + yardsToGo +
                      absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff,
                    data = both, weights = weight)
summary(compare_model)
confint(compare_model)["playActionTRUE:grpthird_short", ]
```


```{r}
## 1. Does pressure cost EPA? (matched plays, weighted)
pressure_epa_model <- lm(expectedPointsAdded ~ any_pressure + playAction + factor(down) +
                           yardsToGo + absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff,
                         data = matched, weights = weight)
summary(pressure_epa_model)
confint(pressure_epa_model)["any_pressure", ]

## 2. Mediation check: does play-action's EPA effect shrink once pressure is in the model?
## Compare playActionTRUE here to 0.111 in epa_matched
summary(pressure_epa_model)$coefficients["playActionTRUE", ]
confint(pressure_epa_model)["playActionTRUE", ]

## 3. Average EPA by pressure and play type (weighted)
wmean_se <- function(x, w) {
  ok <- !is.na(x)
  x <- x[ok]
  w <- w[ok]
  m <- weighted.mean(x, w)
  se <- sqrt(sum(w^2 * (x - m)^2)) / sum(w)
  c(mean = m, se = se)
}

epa_pressure <- matched %>%
  filter(!is.na(any_pressure)) %>%
  mutate(pressure_label = ifelse(any_pressure == 1, "Pressured", "Not pressured")) %>%
  group_by(pressure_label, play_type) %>%
  summarize(plays = n(),
            mean_epa = wmean_se(expectedPointsAdded, weight)["mean"],
            se = wmean_se(expectedPointsAdded, weight)["se"],
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(pressure_label = factor(pressure_label, levels = c("Not pressured", "Pressured")))

epa_pressure

p_pressure_epa <- ggplot(epa_pressure, aes(x = pressure_label, y = mean_epa, fill = play_type)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_epa - 1.96 * se, ymax = mean_epa + 1.96 * se),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.2,
                color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pa_colors) +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Average EPA per dropback (95% CI)",
       fill = NULL) +
  theme_paper

p_pressure_epa
ggsave("figures/fig3_pressure_epa.png", p_pressure_epa, width = 6.5, height = 4, dpi = 300)

## 4. Share of dropbacks pressured by play type (matched), for context
matched %>%
  filter(!is.na(any_pressure)) %>%
  group_by(play_type) %>%
  summarize(pressure_rate = weighted.mean(any_pressure, weight))
```

```{r}
matched_p <- matched %>% filter(!is.na(any_pressure))

get_eff_p <- function(data, label) {
  fit <- lm(expectedPointsAdded ~ playAction + factor(down) + yardsToGo +
              absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff,
            data = data, weights = weight)
  ci <- confint(fit)["playActionTRUE", ]
  data.frame(group = label,
             n_pa = sum(data$playAction),
             estimate = coef(fit)["playActionTRUE"],
             lower = ci[1],
             upper = ci[2])
}

pressure_effects <- rbind(
  get_eff_p(filter(matched_p, any_pressure == 0), "Not pressured"),
  get_eff_p(filter(matched_p, any_pressure == 1), "Pressured")
)
rownames(pressure_effects) <- NULL

pressure_effects <- pressure_effects %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(group, "\n(", format(n_pa, big.mark = ","), " play-action plays)"),
         label = factor(label, levels = label))

pressure_effects

p_press_eff <- ggplot(pressure_effects, aes(x = label, y = estimate)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#0072B2", width = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.15,
                color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_text(aes(y = pmax(upper, 0), label = round(estimate, 2)),
            vjust = -0.6, family = "serif") +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "EPA gained per dropback from play-action (95% CI)") +
  theme_paper

p_press_eff
ggsave("figures/fig3_epa_by_pressure.png", p_press_eff, width = 6.5, height = 4, dpi = 300)

## Does play-action's effect differ when pressured vs. not?
inter_pressure <- lm(expectedPointsAdded ~ playAction * any_pressure + factor(down) +
                       yardsToGo + absoluteYardlineNumber + score_diff,
                     data = matched_p, weights = weight)
summary(inter_pressure)
confint(inter_pressure)["playActionTRUE:any_pressure", ]
```
